mapper.select: SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.permission_id, up.effect, up.created_at, up.created_by, p.code as permission_code, p.name as permission_name FROM user_permission up INNER JOIN permission p ON up.permission_id = p.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY p.sort, p.id

SELECT up.id, up.user_id, up.permission_id, up.effect, up.created_at, up.created_by, p.code as permission_code, p.name as permission_name FROM user_permission up INNER JOIN permission p ON up.permission_id = p.id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND up.effect = #{effect} ORDER BY p.sort, p.id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_permission WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND permission_id = #{permissionId}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO user_permission (user_id, permission_id, effect, created_by) VALUES
(#{up.userId}, #{up.permissionId}, #{up.effect}, #{up.createdBy})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE effect = VALUES(effect), created_by = VALUES(created_by)
